web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's official manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rose to 50.3 in June 2026, indicating expansion and surpassing May's 50.0 mark. The non-manufacturing PMI also improved to 50.2, slightly beating forecasts. The increase was driven by robust tech export demand, particularly for AI-related products, and a recovery in overseas orders as global tensions eased.
